propositions: FixedBench over-action result lacks a plan-review criterion to determine whether a proposed change is actually needed
Bug tickets are gate-exempt and short-circuit to bare PASS without substantive review (verified on bug 5886 with REVIEW_RESULT containing exempt verdict and zero llm_calls)
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate the change is needed (no reproduction or motivation), applying to all ticket types including bug
Bug tickets must receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of the DET floor plus the necessity probe, never blocking a bug

The necessity criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json with advisory posture and no bug suppression, distinct from asserted-capability which checks existing implementations
Both criteria pieces must ship advisory-only and flow into the standing recorder for effectiveness monitoring and later promotion-to-blocking via dogfood decision
